text.p: These are the leading stories in Zambia's newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.

- International monitors working under the auspicies of the Christian Council of Zambia have declared Zambia's general elections free and fair, while a local watchdog group said it could not endorse the results because the process leading to the polls favoured the ruling party.

- The Electoral Commission has advised the opposition Zambia Democratic Congress to gracefully accept defeat and recognise the Frederick Chiluba government, which scored a landslide victory in controversial polls on Monday.
- Five ministers lost their parliamentary seats in general elections as the ruling Movement for Multiparty Democracy continued to enjoy a massive lead as vote counting continued.
